ITEMS.Q: What happens if I go over my monthly conversation limit?
ITEMS.A: Your widget keeps working — nothing shuts off mid-month. Extra conversations on paid plans bill at €1.20 per additional 100 conversations. The Free plan is the only one that pauses at its cap, since it's meant as a taste of the product.
Yes — every paid plan is available on an annual billing cycle at roughly 2 months free (pay for 10, get 12).
Upgrades apply immediately and are prorated. Downgrades take effect at your next billing cycle, so you keep what you already paid for.

ITEMS.Q: Is the Free plan really free forever?
ITEMS.A: Yes. It's intentionally limited (1 website, 50 conversations/mo) so you can fully try the product, not a time-boxed trial.
